body: run.sh now runs 'emily session new' before invoking claude, and the launch prompt tells the session to run 'emily backlog curate --all' and check the observation queue/SECTION 170 for anything filed while offline before picking backlog work (Principle 18). Separately investigated S170-265 (emily cli context / golden doc index hydration): emily context build + emily-agent's internal GoldenDocCompiler both already exist and both are blocked on the same root cause as HITL-11 (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY credit balance dead since 2026-07-19, re-confirmed dead today via a live emily context build --dry-run run — all 45/45 sources failed with 'credit balance too low'). Flagged a side-finding: full-system-context.md's fresh mtime likely masks stale cached compression content, same failure mode already named for GOLDEN.md in HITL-11. No code gap to fix — genuinely blocked on founder topping up credits. root monorepo commit 2505c4e, EMILY BACKLOG.md pending.
